s0101.literal: " The Emperor said: "Follow the former regulations; if others suddenly make requests on their own authority.
s0101.idiomatic: " The Emperor said, "Follow the former regulations; if others suddenly make requests on their own authority.

s0102.literal: " They also said: "Military officers differ from civil officials; fathers and sons and brothers are permitted hereditary succession — this is an institution fixed by Shizu.
s0102.idiomatic: " They also said, "Military officers differ from civil officials; fathers and sons and brothers are permitted hereditary succession — this is an institution fixed by Shizu.

s0103.literal: Recently close attendants have frequently requested ten-thousand-household and thousand-household offices from above; inner edicts were issued, but we ministers have not dared carry them out.
s0103.idiomatic: Recently close attendants have frequently requested ten-thousand-household and thousand-household offices from above; inner edicts were issued, but we ministers have not dared carry them out.

s0104.literal: " The Emperor said: "Carry them out according to regulation.
s0104.idiomatic: " The Emperor said, "Carry them out according to regulation.

s0105.literal: " On jiayin day an edict ordered monks in all monasteries of the interior prefectures, Jiangnan, Koryo, Sichuan, and Yunnan to recite the Buddhist canon for the three palaces' blessings.
s0105.idiomatic: " On jiayin day an edict ordered monks in all monasteries of the interior prefectures, Jiangnan, Koryo, Sichuan, and Yunnan to recite the Buddhist canon for the three palaces' blessings.

s0106.literal: On yimao day the yeke jarquchi Maras was dispatched to the northern army and was given a seal.
s0106.idiomatic: On yimao day the yeke jarquchi Maras was dispatched to the northern army and was given a seal.

s0107.literal: On bingchen day Censor-in-Chief Tasibuhua said: "The duties of the Palace Attendant Service: for memorials from the central secretariat downward, attendants must accompany them in;
s0107.idiomatic: On bingchen day censor-in-chief Tasibuhua said, "The duties of the Palace Attendant Service: for memorials from the central secretariat downward, attendants must accompany them in;

s0108.literal: those not in the roster for memorializing may withdraw;
s0108.idiomatic: those not in the roster for memorializing may withdraw;

s0109.literal: for officials at court assemblies who breach etiquette, they may be impeached;
s0109.idiomatic: for officials at court assemblies who breach etiquette, they may be impeached;

s0110.literal: for those who fall ill or die, notification is required.
s0110.idiomatic: for those who fall ill or die, notification is required.

s0111.literal: We request that the old regulations be followed."
s0111.idiomatic: We request that the old regulations be followed."

s0112.literal: " They also said: "Under the old regulations, when censorial officials within and without impeach someone, others must not interfere.
s0112.idiomatic: " They also said, "Under the old regulations, when censorial officials within and without impeach someone, others must not interfere.

s0113.literal: Yet recently one who accepted bribes was impeached by a surveillance censor; when the case was concluded, he used connections to petition and, under the pretext of business, entered audience to avoid punishment.
s0113.idiomatic: Yet recently one who accepted bribes was impeached by a surveillance censor; when the case was concluded, he used connections to petition and, under the pretext of business, entered audience to avoid punishment.

s0114.literal: We believe that from now on, those found guilty must not be permitted to reach the capital; after their cross-examination is concluded, if they truly have something to say, only then should memorializing be permitted.
s0114.idiomatic: We believe that from now on, those found guilty must not be permitted to reach the capital; after their cross-examination is concluded, if they truly have something to say, only then should memorializing be permitted.

s0116.literal: Tasibuhua also said: "The crown prince has decreed: for corruption offenses of officials, there is no need for the Ministry of Punishments to fix the penalty; those receiving edicts shall be punished by the surveillance commission; when the secretariat and censorate dispatch men to inspect the surveillance commission documents, private obstruction occurs — this is inconvenient.
s0116.idiomatic: Tasibuhua also said, "The crown prince has decreed: for corruption offenses of officials, there is no need for the Ministry of Punishments to fix the penalty; those receiving edicts shall be punished by the surveillance commission; when the secretariat and censorate dispatch men to inspect the surveillance commission documents, private obstruction occurs — this is inconvenient.

s0117.literal: " Grand Councillor Ashabuhua thereupon said: "This is a matter for joint deliberation between the secretariat and censorate; censorate officials should not memorialize alone.
s0117.idiomatic: " Grand councillor Ashabuhua thereupon said, "This is a matter for joint deliberation between the secretariat and censorate; censorate officials should not memorialize alone.

s0118.literal: " The Emperor said: "This is a censorate matter — Ashabuhua, do not speak rashly.
s0118.idiomatic: " The Emperor said, "This is a censorate matter — Ashabuhua, do not speak rashly.

s0119.literal: What the censorate officials say is correct; carry it out as memorialized.
s0119.idiomatic: What the censorate officials say is correct; carry it out as memorialized.

s0120.literal: " Tasibuhua and Toghto were both granted left chancellor by remote appointment.
s0120.idiomatic: " Tasibuhua and Toghto were both granted left chancellor by remote appointment.

s0121.literal: On wuwu day King Wang Ju of Koryo was promoted to Prince of Shenyang, and made crown prince grand tutor and imperial son-in-law director.
s0121.idiomatic: On wuwu day King Wang Ju of Koryo was promoted to Prince of Shenyang, and made crown prince grand tutor and imperial son-in-law director.

s0122.literal: The crown prince's Household Steward Bureau, Principality Rectification Bureau, Extended Celebration Bureau, Qu Music Agency, and Palace Provisions Agency were established.
s0122.idiomatic: The crown prince's Household Steward Bureau, Principality Rectification Bureau, Extended Celebration Bureau, Qu Music Agency, and Palace Provisions Agency were established.

s0123.literal: On jiwei day Prince of Ningyuan Kuokuochu was enfeoffed as Prince of Ning, and granted a gold seal.
s0123.idiomatic: On jiwei day Prince of Ningyuan Kuokuochu was enfeoffed as Prince of Ning, and granted a gold seal.

s0124.literal: On gengshen day Tasibuhua, by remote appointment left chancellor and acting censor-in-chief, was made right chancellor.
s0124.idiomatic: On gengshen day Tasibuhua, by remote appointment left chancellor and acting censor-in-chief, was made right chancellor.

s0125.literal: On xinyou day Bianliang, Nanyang, Guide, Jiangxi, and Huguang suffered flooding; Baoding subordinate counties suffered locusts.
s0125.idiomatic: On xinyou day Bianliang, Nanyang, Guide, Jiangxi, and Huguang suffered flooding; Baoding subordinate counties suffered locusts.

s0126.literal: Seventh month, autumn, guihai new moon: Prince Tula was enfeoffed as Prince of Yue.
s0126.idiomatic: Seventh month, autumn, guihai new moon: Prince Tula was enfeoffed as Prince of Yue.

s0127.literal: Prince Chubei said: "Runaway tenant farmers of Guazhou and Shazhou who have gradually come of age — we ask that they be registered under our command.
s0127.idiomatic: Prince Chubei said, "Runaway tenant farmers of Guazhou and Shazhou who have gradually come of age — we ask that they be registered under our command.

s0128.literal: " Central secretariat officials said: "Although Guazhou is princely domain, its people serve on relay stations — Chubei's request should not be followed.
s0128.idiomatic: " Central secretariat officials said, "Although Guazhou is princely domain, its people serve on relay stations — Chubei's request should not be followed.

s0129.literal: " The Insignia and Girdle Pendants Store was promoted to the Bureau of Insignia and Girdle Pendants, rank 2b; Aranabakha was granted ten thousand ingots of notes.
s0129.idiomatic: " The Insignia and Girdle Pendants Store was promoted to the Bureau of Insignia and Girdle Pendants, rank 2b; Aranabakha was granted 10,000 ingots of notes.

s0130.literal: On jiazi day Censor-in-Chief Teguder, Privy Council Vice Director Targhutai, and Central Secretariat Grand Councillor Chuangwu'er were dispatched to announce the accession at the southern suburb altar.
s0130.idiomatic: On jiazi day censor-in-chief Teguder, privy council vice director Targhutai, and central secretariat grand councillor Chuangwu'er were dispatched to announce the accession at the southern suburb altar.

s0131.literal: On bingyin day, because placing the Lidian Mongol ten-thousand-household command under the Tubo pacification commission was inconvenient, they were ordered to remain as before under Temür's pacification commission to defend Shaan Prefecture.
s0131.idiomatic: On bingyin day, because placing the Lidian Mongol ten-thousand-household command under the Tubo pacification commission was inconvenient, they were ordered to remain as before under Temür's pacification commission to defend Shaan Prefecture.

s0132.literal: Princes and imperial sons-in-law coming to audience were not permitted relay unless by imperial order.
s0132.idiomatic: Princes and imperial sons-in-law coming to audience were not permitted relay unless by imperial order.

s0133.literal: Central Secretariat Associate Administrator Zhao Rongrong was made crown prince household steward.
s0133.idiomatic: Central secretariat associate administrator Zhao Rongrong was made crown prince household steward.

s0134.literal: For protecting merit, Mingli was made grand steward of the palace, and his wife Meixian was enfeoffed as Lady of Shunguo.
s0134.idiomatic: For protecting merit, Mingli was made grand steward of the palace, and his wife Meixian was enfeoffed as Lady of Shunguo.

s0135.literal: Chuangwu'er's soldiers were granted sixty thousand ingots of notes and twenty thousand bolts of silks and cloths.
s0135.idiomatic: Chuangwu'er's soldiers were granted 60,000 ingots of notes and 20,000 bolts of silks and cloths.

s0136.literal: Fei'eryaermidi and Tegeden were dispatched to the Western Regions to fetch the Buddhist bowl and relics; Fei'eryaermidi was granted Xuanzheng commissioner by remote appointment, and Tegeden grand councillor by remote appointment.
s0136.idiomatic: Fei'eryaermidi and Tegeden were dispatched to the Western Regions to fetch the Buddhist bowl and relics; Fei'eryaermidi was granted Xuanzheng commissioner by remote appointment, and Tegeden grand councillor by remote appointment.

s0137.literal: Halaqsun Dalaqan, grand tutor and right chancellor, and Tarqai, grand guardian and left chancellor, were jointly ordered to administer central secretariat routine affairs; an edict notified court and country.
s0137.idiomatic: Halaqsun Dalaqan, grand tutor and right chancellor, and Tarqai, grand guardian and left chancellor, were jointly ordered to administer central secretariat routine affairs; an edict notified court and country.

s0138.literal: On jisi day the moon encroached upon Kang.
s0138.idiomatic: On jisi day the moon encroached upon Kang.

s0139.literal: The Palace Tutor Office was established, with crown prince grand tutor, junior tutor, grand preceptor, junior preceptor, grand guardian, junior guardian, guest of honor, left and right lecturers, supporters of virtue, subordinates of the crown prince, groom of the heir, chief of the crown prince's household, assistants, chief of classics, assistants, attendants, literary officers, interpreters, proofreaders, correctors of texts, and the like.
s0139.idiomatic: The Palace Tutor Office was established, with crown prince grand tutor, junior tutor, grand preceptor, junior preceptor, grand guardian, junior guardian, guest of honor, left and right lecturers, supporters of virtue, subordinates of the crown prince, groom of the heir, chief of the crown prince's household, assistants, chief of classics, assistants, attendants, literary officers, interpreters, proofreaders, correctors of texts, and the like.

s0140.literal: On renshen day Censor-in-Chief Teguder, Central Secretariat Grand Councillor Chuangwu'er, and Privy Council Vice Director Borlanxi were dispatched to announce the accession at the imperial ancestral temple.
s0140.idiomatic: On renshen day censor-in-chief Teguder, central secretariat grand councillor Chuangwu'er, and privy council vice director Borlanxi were dispatched to announce the accession at the imperial ancestral temple.

s0141.literal: Anxi, Pingjiang, and Jizhou circuits were made the crown prince's fief; Yuezhou Route was made Prince Tula's fief.
s0141.idiomatic: Anxi, Pingjiang, and Jizhou circuits were made the crown prince's fief; Yuezhou Route was made Prince Tula's fief.

s0142.literal: Prince Babusha was granted ten thousand ingots of notes.
s0142.idiomatic: Prince Babusha was granted 10,000 ingots of notes.

s0143.literal: On guiyou day the Karakorum pacification commission was abolished and a branch secretariat established, along with the Qinghai region pacification commission commander-in-chief headquarters and Karakorum administration commissionerate.
s0143.idiomatic: On guiyou day the Karakorum pacification commission was abolished and a branch secretariat established, along with the Qinghai region pacification commission commander-in-chief headquarters and Karakorum administration commissionerate.

s0144.literal: Grand Preceptor Ochicharu was made right chancellor of the Karakorum branch secretariat; Central Secretariat Right Chancellor Halaqsun Dalaqan was made left chancellor of the Karakorum branch secretariat, continuing as before as grand tutor and recorder of state affairs of military importance.
s0144.idiomatic: Grand preceptor Ochicharu was made right chancellor of the Karakorum branch secretariat; central secretariat right chancellor Halaqsun Dalaqan was made left chancellor of the Karakorum branch secretariat, continuing as before as grand tutor and recorder of state affairs of military importance.

s0145.literal: Jiang-Zhe suffered flooding; the people faced famine; an edict ordered three months of relief grain; wine, vinegar, gate levies, and tax items were all remitted for one year.
s0145.idiomatic: Jiang-Zhe suffered flooding; the people faced famine; an edict ordered three months of relief grain; wine, vinegar, gate levies, and tax items were all remitted for one year.

s0146.literal: On yihai day Yongping Route was made the Princess of Lu's fief; rent and local products were all granted to her.
s0146.idiomatic: On yihai day Yongping Route was made the Princess of Lu's fief; rent and local products were all granted to her.

s0147.literal: Prince Tula was granted ten thousand ingots of notes; Udus Bugha's department thirty-five thousand two hundred twenty ingots.
s0147.idiomatic: Prince Tula was granted 10,000 ingots of notes; Udus Bugha's department 35,220 ingots.

s0148.literal: On bingzi day Jiang-Zhe Branch Secretariat Grand Councillor Tash Kayal and Privy Council Director Chuangwu'er were both made central secretariat grand councillors.
s0148.idiomatic: On bingzi day Jiang-Zhe branch secretariat grand councillor Tash Kayal and privy council director Chuangwu'er were both made central secretariat grand councillors.

s0149.literal: On dingchou day Prince Babusha was enfeoffed as Prince of Qi; Dilegenei as Prince of Ji; Dilegenei Buqa as Prince of Northern Ning; Grand Preceptor Ochicharu as Prince of Qiyang; Grand Councillor Toghan was promoted to grand marshal.
s0149.idiomatic: On dingchou day Prince Babusha was enfeoffed as Prince of Qi; Dilegenei as Prince of Ji; Dilegenei Buqa as Prince of Northern Ning; grand preceptor Ochicharu as Prince of Qiyang; grand councillor Toghan was promoted to grand marshal.

s0150.literal: Left Chancellor Tarqai was made right chancellor of the central secretariat and supervisor of the state history; Censor-in-Chief Tasibuhua was made left chancellor; Jiang-Zhe Branch Secretariat Grand Councillor Jiao Hua and Henan-Huaibei Branch Secretariat Grand Councillor Fakhr al-Din were both made central secretariat grand councillors; Grand Councillor Temüder was made Jiangxi Branch Secretariat grand councillor.
s0150.idiomatic: Left chancellor Tarqai was made right chancellor of the central secretariat and supervisor of the state history; censor-in-chief Tasibuhua was made left chancellor; Jiang-Zhe branch secretariat grand councillor Jiao Hua and Henan-Huaibei branch secretariat grand councillor Fakhr al-Din were both made central secretariat grand councillors; grand councillor Temüder was made Jiangxi branch secretariat grand councillor.

s0151.literal: On wuyin day Palace Equestrian Commissioner Qoshayar, Temür Buqa, and Music Bureau darughachi Shadi were all granted grand councillor by remote appointment as Jade Inner Music Bureau commissioners.
s0151.idiomatic: On wuyin day palace equestrian commissioner Qoshayar, Temür Buqa, and music bureau darughachi Shadi were all granted grand councillor by remote appointment as Jade Inner Music Bureau commissioners.

s0152.literal: On jimao day Hanlin Academy Director Beg Buqa was made central secretariat grand councillor.
s0152.idiomatic: On jimao day Hanlin Academy director Beg Buqa was made central secretariat grand councillor.

s0153.literal: On gengchen day Censorate Vice Director Jirghalang was made censor-in-chief.
s0153.idiomatic: On gengchen day censorate vice director Jirghalang was made censor-in-chief.

s0154.literal: On xinsi day the Sage Master of Culture was further enfeoffed as the Great Completion Sage Master of Culture.
s0154.idiomatic: On xinsi day the Sage Master of Culture was further enfeoffed as the Great Completion Sage Master of Culture.

s0155.literal: Right Chancellor Tarqai and Left Chancellor Tasibuhua said: "For central secretariat routine affairs, one or two close attendants among colleagues often report upward without awaiting joint deliberation — this is inconvenient.
s0155.idiomatic: Right chancellor Tarqai and left chancellor Tasibuhua said, "For central secretariat routine affairs, one or two close attendants among colleagues often report upward without awaiting joint deliberation — this is inconvenient.

s0156.literal: From now on on all matters, we request joint deliberation before memorializing.
s0156.idiomatic: From now on on all matters, we request joint deliberation before memorializing.

s0157.literal: " The Emperor said: "What you say is correct.
s0157.idiomatic: " The Emperor said, "What you say is correct.

s0158.literal: From now on on routine government, what lacks joint deliberation must not be memorialized.
s0158.idiomatic: From now on on routine government, what lacks joint deliberation must not be memorialized.

s0159.literal: " A traveling works ministry was established at Wangwuchadu.
s0159.idiomatic: " A traveling works ministry was established at Wangwuchadu.

s0160.literal: Yeghichi, by remote appointment left chancellor and associate privy council director, was made privy council director;
s0160.idiomatic: Yeghichi, by remote appointment left chancellor and associate privy council director, was made privy council director;

s0161.literal: Censorate Vice Director Wang Shou and Jiang-Zhe Branch Secretariat Left Vice Chancellor Hao Tianting were both made central secretariat left vice chancellors.
s0161.idiomatic: Censorate vice director Wang Shou and Jiang-Zhe branch secretariat left vice chancellor Hao Tianting were both made central secretariat left vice chancellors.

s0162.literal: On renwu day Mars encroached upon Southern Dipper.
s0162.idiomatic: On renwu day Mars encroached upon Southern Dipper.

s0163.literal: Censor-in-Chief Teguder, Privy Council Director Targhutai, and Central Secretariat Grand Councillor Chuangwu'er were ordered to announce the accession at the altars of soil and grain.
s0163.idiomatic: Censor-in-chief Teguder, privy council director Targhutai, and central secretariat grand councillor Chuangwu'er were ordered to announce the accession at the altars of soil and grain.

s0164.literal: On guiwei day the Utilization Store was promoted to the Utilization Bureau, rank 2b.
s0164.idiomatic: On guiwei day the Utilization Store was promoted to the Utilization Bureau, rank 2b.

s0165.literal: On jiashen day Shams al-Din was dispatched as envoy to the Western Regions and granted Fujian Circuit pacification commissioner by remote appointment.
s0165.idiomatic: On jiashen day Shams al-Din was dispatched as envoy to the Western Regions and granted Fujian Circuit pacification commissioner by remote appointment.

s0166.literal: On yiyou day Princess Shouning was granted ten thousand ingots of notes.
s0166.idiomatic: On yiyou day Princess Shouning was granted 10,000 ingots of notes.

s0167.literal: On bingxu day, because the interior prefectures had a lean year, princely guards returning to Dadu were selected and admitted.
s0167.idiomatic: On bingxu day, because the interior prefectures had a lean year, princely guards returning to Dadu were selected and admitted.

s0168.literal: At the Karakorum branch secretariat's request, following Gansu branch secretariat precedent, two thousand ingots of notes were granted, with annual interest collected to supplement supplies; fishing nets were also granted to impoverished commoners.
s0168.idiomatic: At the Karakorum branch secretariat's request, following Gansu branch secretariat precedent, 2,000 ingots of notes were granted, with annual interest collected to supplement supplies; fishing nets were also granted to impoverished commoners.

s0169.literal: Censor-in-Chief Yoroklu said: "Under the old regulations, the central secretariat, privy council, censorate, and Xuanzheng Bureau were permitted to select their own personnel; all other agencies followed central secretariat selection; close attendants were not permitted to memorialize on their own — thus the norm was not disrupted.
s0169.idiomatic: Censor-in-chief Yoroklu said, "Under the old regulations, the central secretariat, privy council, censorate, and Xuanzheng Bureau were permitted to select their own personnel; all other agencies followed central secretariat selection; close attendants were not permitted to memorialize on their own — thus the norm was not disrupted.

s0170.literal: " The Emperor praised and accepted this.
s0170.idiomatic: " The Emperor praised and accepted this.

s0171.literal: Xuanzheng Bureau Associate Commissioner Boladai was made central secretariat left vice chancellor; Central Secretariat Associate Administrator Qincha was made Sichuan Branch Secretariat left vice chancellor.
s0171.idiomatic: Xuanzheng Bureau associate commissioner Boladai was made central secretariat left vice chancellor; central secretariat associate administrator Qincha was made Sichuan branch secretariat left vice chancellor.

s0172.literal: Subordinate prefectures of Jiang-Zhe, Huguang, and Jiangxi suffered famine; an edict ordered branch secretariats to distribute grain in relief.
s0172.idiomatic: Subordinate prefectures of Jiang-Zhe, Huguang, and Jiangxi suffered famine; an edict ordered branch secretariats to distribute grain in relief.

s0173.literal: On dinghai day Oljei was sent together with Qirghis Qidan Yinan to levy tribute falcons, castrated horses, and hunting hawks from the Kirghiz tribe.
s0173.idiomatic: On dinghai day Oljei was sent together with Qirghis Qidan Yinan to levy tribute falcons, castrated horses, and hunting hawks from the Kirghiz tribe.

s0174.literal: Mongol armies of Shandong and Hebei reported famine; officials were dispatched for relief.
s0174.idiomatic: Mongol armies of Shandong and Hebei reported famine; officials were dispatched for relief.

s0175.literal: Impoverished commoners under the Prince of Jin's department were granted fifty thousand ingots of notes.
s0175.idiomatic: Impoverished commoners under the Prince of Jin's department were granted 50,000 ingots of notes.

s0176.literal: On jichou day Tarqai and Tasibuhua said: "In the former Nayan rebellion, captives were all registered under household rolls by Shizu's order.
s0176.idiomatic: On jichou day Tarqai and Tasibuhua said, "In the former Nayan rebellion, captives were all registered under household rolls by Shizu's order.

s0177.literal: Recently close attendants requested they be returned to Prince Toghto; he immediately dispatched men to seize and register them.
s0177.idiomatic: Recently close attendants requested they be returned to Prince Toghto; he immediately dispatched men to seize and register them.

s0178.literal: We believe this matter has a prior institution; now that they have been returned to Toghto's department, Liaoyang branch secretariat officials Xue Chagan and others should be dispatched to instruct them — those already seized shall all be returned to their masters.
s0178.idiomatic: We believe this matter has a prior institution; now that they have been returned to Toghto's department, Liaoyang branch secretariat officials Xue Chagan and others should be dispatched to instruct them — those already seized shall all be returned to their masters.

s0180.literal: Anxi and other prefectures suffered drought and famine; twenty-eight thousand shi of grain were distributed in relief.
s0180.idiomatic: Anxi and other prefectures suffered drought and famine; 28,000 shi of grain were distributed in relief.

s0181.literal: On gengyin day the Extended Blessings Bureau was established, rank 3a.
s0181.idiomatic: On gengyin day the Extended Blessings Bureau was established, rank 3a.

s0182.literal: On xinmao day an edict declared: Tangut tlukhtu household registers having been fixed, those who entered princely and imperial son-in-law departments to avoid corvée and those who concealed themselves are all guilty.
s0182.idiomatic: On xinmao day an edict declared: Tangut tlukhtu household registers having been fixed, those who entered princely and imperial son-in-law departments to avoid corvée and those who concealed themselves are all guilty.

s0183.literal: Two thousand soldiers were mobilized to build a residence for Prince Jin's Yesün Temür.
s0183.idiomatic: 2,000 soldiers were mobilized to build a residence for Prince Jin's Yesün Temür.

s0184.literal: That month, subordinate prefectures of Jiang-Zhe, Huguang, Jiangxi, Henan, and Liang-Huai suffered famine; grain was converted from salt and tea tax notes for relief, and officials were dispatched.
s0184.idiomatic: That month, subordinate prefectures of Jiang-Zhe, Huguang, Jiangxi, Henan, and Liang-Huai suffered famine; grain was converted from salt and tea tax notes for relief, and officials were dispatched.

s0185.literal: An edict declared: wealthy households able to distribute private grain as relief loans might be granted official rank in measured amounts.
s0185.idiomatic: An edict declared: wealthy households able to distribute private grain as relief loans might be granted official rank in measured amounts.

s0186.literal: Baoding, Hejian, Jinning, and other prefectures suffered flooding; Dezhou suffered locusts.
s0186.idiomatic: Baoding, Hejian, Jinning, and other prefectures suffered flooding; Dezhou suffered locusts.

s0187.literal: Eighth month, jiawu day: Central Secretariat officials said: "For inner edicts granting offices, there are more than eight hundred eighty persons; of these three hundred have been appointed, and more than five hundred remain undecided.
s0187.idiomatic: Eighth month, jiawu day: central secretariat officials said, "For inner edicts granting offices, there are more than 880 persons; of these 300 have been appointed, and more than 500 remain undecided.

s0188.literal: We request that from now on those who memorialize beyond procedure not be granted office.
s0188.idiomatic: We request that from now on those who memorialize beyond procedure not be granted office.

s0189.literal: " The Emperor said: "What you say is correct.
s0189.idiomatic: " The Emperor said, "What you say is correct.

s0190.literal: From now on those who do not memorialize through the central secretariat must not be granted office.
s0190.idiomatic: From now on those who do not memorialize through the central secretariat must not be granted office.

s0191.literal: " They also said: "External officials bearing chancellor titles is not regulation — please do not grant them.
s0191.idiomatic: " They also said, "External officials bearing chancellor titles is not regulation — please do not grant them.

s0193.literal: They also said: "Those due to be granted at court assemblies total three million five hundred thousand ingots of notes; one million seven hundred thousand have been given, and one million eight hundred thousand remain undistributed; stores in both capitals are already depleted.
s0193.idiomatic: They also said, "Those due to be granted at court assemblies total 3,500,000 ingots of notes; 1,700,000 have been given, and 1,800,000 remain undistributed; stores in both capitals are already depleted.

s0194.literal: From now on special memorials requesting rewards should temporarily cease.
s0194.idiomatic: From now on special memorials requesting rewards should temporarily cease.

s0195.literal: " Imperial order: "From now on whoever requests rewards must not be memorialized.
s0195.idiomatic: " Imperial order: "From now on whoever requests rewards must not be memorialized.

s0196.literal: " Censorate officials said: "The central secretariat, privy council, censorate, and Xuanzheng Bureau selecting their own officials has standing precedent.
s0196.idiomatic: " Censorate officials said, "The central secretariat, privy council, censorate, and Xuanzheng Bureau selecting their own officials has standing precedent.

s0197.literal: Now surveillance censors and surveillance commission officials are not chosen by their own bureau but by requests from various ministers, with inner edicts issued — this is not ancestral law.
s0197.idiomatic: Now surveillance censors and surveillance commission officials are not chosen by their own bureau but by requests from various ministers, with inner edicts issued — this is not ancestral law.

s0198.literal: " The Emperor said: "Wherever this occurs, you are not to carry it out.
s0198.idiomatic: " The Emperor said, "Wherever this occurs, you are not to carry it out.

s0199.literal: " Eastern Zhe, Western Zhe, Hubei, and Jiangdong prefectures and counties suffered famine; officials were dispatched for relief.
s0199.idiomatic: " Eastern Zhe, Western Zhe, Hubei, and Jiangdong prefectures and counties suffered famine; officials were dispatched for relief.

s0200.literal: Mountain-rear relay households were granted notes, five hundred ingots per relay station.
s0200.idiomatic: Mountain-rear relay households were granted notes, 500 ingots per relay station.
